policy: Every lore/phase1/phase2/phase3 Markdown document has one audited owner, phase/module/capability, status, source/after SHA, evidence and stopline.
maintenancePolicy: Legacy structural entries retain their historical status; only explicit per-document review deltas with matching SHA grant new semantic credit. Index generation is read-only over this catalog and cannot classify or mark documents reviewed.

loader.contract: load manifest, verify shard SHA/native entry fields, then return deterministic merged entries
